newsitem.title: CANADA: Northern Telecom says CFO to resign.
newsitem.headline: Northern Telecom says CFO to resign.

text.p: Northern Telecom Ltd said on Monday its chief financial officer, Peter Currie, will leave to become executive vice-president and CFO of the Royal Bank of Canada.

Wes Scott, 50, Nortel's executive vice-president, corporate, will assume the CFO's responsibilities effective April 6. From 1993 to 1995, Scott was president and chief executive officer of Stentor Resource Centre, the product and service development arm of Stentor, a group of nine Canadian telephone companies. He joined Nortel in 1995 as executive vice-president, corporate.
"Peter Currie was an excellent CFO and we wish him well in his new position with Canada's largest financial organization," Jean Monty, vice-chairman and chief executive officer, said in a statement.
"However, we are fortunate that we have an outstanding finance team at Nortel, fully capable of furthering both our internal and external financial activities," he added.
Monty has said he will step down as chief executive of Nortel in October.
